title: Chapter 267 Killing The Hellhound Boss
content:
Chapter 267 Killing The Hellhound Boss

Wang Shuo was a little puzzled, why did the other vicious dogs not attack?

Then he thought, maybe this golden boss hadn't fought for too long, and wanted to establish prestige in front of other vicious dogs!

Whatever the reason, Wang Shuo focused on attacking.

After a round of skill attacks, Wang Shuo and Gude directly knocked off one-third of the boss's health.

"Woof..."

The three heads kept barking.

The black head spit out a black smoke, the gray head spit out yellow flame smoke, and the white head spit out light white smoke.

The black and yellow smoke caused a lot of damage to Gong Zheng. Fortunately, he had petrified skin and was not burned.

Gude and Wang Shuo took the opportunity to stay away and were not hurt.

The white smoke spit out by the boss lingered around it, constantly wandering on the wounds on its body.

Those shocking wounds healed quickly at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Seeing this magical scene, Wang Shuo was helpless. Now he couldn't get close to the boss at all.

Gude found the right opportunity and kept using "Three Stars in a Row" and "Ice and Fire Double Arrows".

This long-range attack made the boss even more furious.

He wanted to rush over, but was blocked by Gong Zheng.

When the smoke was almost dissipated, Wang Shuo joined the battle again.

The surrounding vicious dogs looked around, and several people were at maximum firepower output.

After another round of attacks, the health of the hellhound reached the bottom.

At this time, it didn't pretend anymore. With a "woof woof", the surrounding vicious dogs also pounced on it.

Wang Shuo's heart sank, and the situation worsened.

He hurriedly took out a handful of thunder that had not been used up before.

Throw it out.

"Bang, bang"

Explosions rang out one after another.

The surrounding vicious dogs were frightened and immediately fled in all directions.

Even the golden boss was frightened.

While it was stunned, Wang Shuo used another set of combos.

In order to prevent it from escaping, Wang Shuo directly used the "Iron Chain Binding" skill.

Gude "swish" two arrows, and Wang Shuo also used the "Dragon Strike".

The three-headed dog of hell finally fell to the ground.

[You killed the golden boss of the three-headed dog of hell, and your level was increased to level 33. ]

Upgraded!

Wang Shuo had accumulated a lot of experience in the previous battle, and after killing the boss, he finally upgraded again.

At the same time, Gude and Gong Zheng's levels were also upgraded by 1 level.

Three round beads the size of pigeon eggs rolled down on the spot.

Wang Shuo was about to go forward to check.

Da Huang, Er Hei, Xiao Ha Ba, three dogs, were faster than him.

They ran over quickly and swallowed the beads in one gulp.

At the same time, they devoured the corpse of the three-headed dog of hell in big mouthfuls.

Seeing this situation, Wang Shuo could only shake his head helplessly.

Seeing how impatient they were, the boss's flesh and blood must have helped them evolve.

Sure enough, it didn't take long for them to devour the corpse.

Wang Shuo's jaw dropped!

Three small dogs actually ate a whole boss as strong as a bull.

At this moment, the three dogs also changed.

Their size changed, sometimes big, sometimes small, and the color of their bodies kept changing.

About half an hour later, the most magical scene happened.

The three dogs actually merged!

Became a new hellhound.

Wang Shuo was stunned!

"Woof, woof..."

Da Huang, Er Hei, and Xiao Ha Ba kept barking.

The three-headed dogs that were fleeing around also barked, and then gathered around.

It seemed that Da Huang and the others had become the new king of the three-headed dogs.

A new idea popped up in Wang Shuo's mind.

He immediately walked over and flew onto Da Huang and the others.

As his own pets, they were still very docile.

Looking at the three-headed dogs all over the mountains, he thought that if he could form a cavalry like this, then...

It would be amazing!
